subject: Sponsored credits request for Sandcastle VPC evaluation (SOC2 gating)
messages:
From: Alex Marino <alex.marino@sandcastlehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Request: VPC PoC credits for SOC2 evaluation

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Sandcastle Health has a security requirement to run any POC inside a private VPC to validate SOC2 controls. We want to run a 30–60 day evaluation of your Private offering (VPC + private control plane) against our ingestion and deid pipeline.

High-level ask:
- Sponsored credits for a VPC PoC (30–60 days) to cover ~200 GPU hours and ~75k token-equivalent generation during validation.
- Temporary SLA exception and access to audit logs for the trial.

I've attached an environment_requirements.pdf that shows our architecture and sample data volumes.

Can you advise process and whether Redwood can provide sponsored credits tied to security review milestones? We're trying to get security sign-off by July 30.

Best,
Alex Marino
Head of Integrations, Sandcastle Health
Attachment: environment_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Marino <alex.marino@sandcastlehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T12:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC PoC credits for SOC2 evaluation

Alex —

Appreciate the details and the diagram. Short answer: yes, we can sponsor a VPC PoC in cases where security gating is blocking evaluation. We typically do that with a conditional credit package tied to milestones (evidence upload, short security review, limited audit log retention).

Proposed next steps:
1) Dev — can you list the minimal SOC2 artifacts you need and any IP range/access constraints?
2) I will coordinate an approval path for a conditional credit grant (we usually do a mix of token credits + reserved GPU hours).
3) Laura / Finance — can we route a credit MOU and get a quick sign-off?

Target: include security checklist and a signed credit MOU by 7/10 so Sandcastle can start the private evaluation the week of 7/13.

Alex — can you confirm the 200 GPU hours / 75k token estimate is sufficient? Also flag any strict data residency or logging retention constraints.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Alex Marino <alex.marino@sandcastlehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T10:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: VPC PoC credits for SOC2 evaluation

Alex / Sean —

Quick checklist from Infra/Sec for a short private VPC PoC. If Sandcastle can provide the following we can keep the trial fairly lightweight:
- SOC2 report or SOC2-in-progress evidence (penetration test summary, controls matrix)
- Architecture diagram (you already sent this — thanks) + expected QPS and peak seq lengths
- IP ranges and any egress rules for the private control plane
- NDA or DPA if PII/PHI is involved (we have a quick DPA template)

For the credit mechanics: we generally provision a temporary private deployment with audit log access and a time-limited credit bucket. We can also enable export of audit logs to the customer's S3 for review.

Please attach the SOC2 evidence and a short architecture note with expected load. If anything is PHI, note that explicitly so we can toggle retention and KMS policies.

On the GPU estimate: 200 hours seems reasonable for your described pipeline but send a sample job size (GPU type / batch size).

—Dev
Dev Patel
Security & Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Team / Alex —

Finance note: we can approve a sponsored credit package subject to the following:
- Signed credit MOU that limits credits to a dedicated VPC for the PoC and lists milestones for evidence delivery.
- A nominal refundable PO or purchase commitment if you exceed the credit bucket (standard for sponsored trials with reserved capacity).
- HubSpot deal record or legal contact for the MOU.

Alex: if you can confirm the HubSpot deal id or provide a PO contact we'll prepare the MOU. I dropped a placeholder DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/sandcastle-credit-mou — we can prefill with the proposed credit amounts and milestones.

Also: please confirm whether Sandcastle needs a formal SLA exception for the trial (we can add a temporary note in the MOU).

Thanks — Neha
